authority.scope: Four requested natural-environment groups; authorial world-setting adoption.

rules.hydrology: Adopt phase40 reference100-year-end storage and cumulative budgets, including all23022 reaches, as the fixed reference hydrological state. Original ocean and lake masks remain original substrate classifications; additional retained water is an overlay.
rules.season: Adopt twelve prescribed representative periods. Cyclic lookup is a world-calendar prescription, not a time-integrated coupled simulation.
rules.routes: Adopt phase41 centreline and valley geometry. Three non-junction crossings become explicit independent subsurface passages on the lower bed, preserving graph connections. X2 includes a locally inverted conduit bed; its discharge is prescribed as a natural pressure passage. Surface Manning profiles do not certify conduit pressure or head loss.
rules.cover: Assign every native cell one land-cover class. Original lakes and reference retained water first; authored arid-conflict flags override terrestrial forest; perennial snow becomes stationary icefield; grounded wetland evidence becomes wetland; unsupported wetness4 becomes moist meadow; flood-exposed forest becomes flood-tolerant woodland; remaining holds use explicit biome/temperature/rainfall rules.
rules.boundaries: Native-cell polygons are the canonical forest/wetland/water boundaries. Grid0.234375deg is the resolution of this edition; display noise is not adopted.
rules.snow: Preserve phase43 tenth-year SWE mass. The top min(SWE,500mm) is snow at250kg/m3; remaining mass is compacted ice at917kg/m3. All perennial icefields are prescribed stationary, velocity0; this is an authored static-state rule, not a glacier-flow solution.
rules.ice: Adopt phase43 reference120-step ice thickness. Retain60/120 differences as research uncertainty without leaving a choice of canonical values.
rules.channel: Prescribe phase43 seasonal discharge. With ice>=1cm, solve a covered trapezoidal Manning section at n=.045 with fixed open-water bottom width; include the ice underside in wetted perimeter and ice displacement in stage. Open-water n=.035. Q=0 retains the mean-flow pool, while the one all-year-dry reach has no water. These are quasi-steady prescribed sections, not unsteady backwater feedback to basin storage.
rules.coupling: A multi-scale prescribed reference world: basin budgets, channel normal-flow profiles and thermal boundary states are fixed contracts. Full terrain/vegetation/glacier/ice feedback is outside this edition's simulator, and is not described as verified physics.
rules.precedence: This explicit adopted edition supersedes research hold labels for the four world-definition groups only. Historical research files, uncertainties, original inputs, economic and political records stay unchanged. Future changes require a new version.

physicalValidation: Not a certification of fully coupled physical realism or observational accuracy.
